- File: .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml
Line or code reference: lines ~1423-1429, ~1431-1436 (jq select expressions)
Problem: JQ exclusion expression readability/maintenance risk — `select((.event == "dynamic" or (.name | test("copilot"; "i"))) | not)` groups an OR with parentheses but applies `| not` at the end, which may confuse maintainers and invite future mis-edits.
Why it fails at runtime: A future modification touching the exclusion could inadvertently break the filter due to misunderstanding of operator precedence and grouping, causing a Copilot run to be re-admitted and Phase 4 to short-circuit again.
SEVERITY: MAJOR
ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4

- File: .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml
Line or code reference: lines 1410-1412 (first jq filter) and lines ~1430-1432 (legacy fallback)
Problem: The Copilot exclusion `select((.event == "dynamic" or (.name | test("copilot"; "i"))) | not)` is applied *inside* the name-match `select(...)` for the primary PIN_SHA query (and similarly in the fallback). A workflow run whose `.name` does *not* contain "Review|review|autofix|self-healing" is never considered, even if it would otherwise be excluded by the Copilot rule.
Why it fails at runtime: The `as $m` candidate set can silently drop real review/autofix runs whose names have drifted (or future variants added to the positive regex) because the exclusion logic never sees them; the wait loop could fall back to stale/in-progress siblings or time out exactly as before the fix (observed pattern on prior runs like 27328808462).
SEVERITY: MAJOR
ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- File: .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml
Line or code reference: jq filter at lines 1410 and 1430 (the `select((.event == "dynamic" or (.name | test("copilot"; "i"))) | not)` construct)
Problem: The boolean negation around the OR is syntactically valid but visually ambiguous; maintainers may misread the precedence when extending the exclusion list.
Why it fails at runtime: A mis-edited filter could re-admit Copilot runs (or exclude legitimate ones), causing the exact premature-success + unrestored-canary failure that this PR was written to prevent.
SEVERITY: NIT
ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
